For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. WANT MOIST CHICKEN? These are the 2 simple cooking hacks for the juiciest chicken you’ve ever had. I usually do chicken thighs, but this is an amazing way to make regular chicken super moist! You need a little baking soda, to cook with the lid on & let it rest, and you’ll never have dry boring chicken again. Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice.
